display: 🗺️  Set up my CRM from scratch

content:
I run LocaForce, a small equipment rental company. Our brand uses bold orange (#F97316) and dark charcoal (#1C1C1E) with a Montserrat font — sturdy and industrial. 

My fleet includes tools and machinery I rent to individuals and construction companies (scaffolding, compressors, concrete mixers, aerial lifts, etc.). Each piece of equipment has its own record: category, model, serial number, current status (available, rented, under maintenance, decommissioned), total usage hours, and purchase date. 

Rentals are the core of my business: a rental links a client to one or more pieces of equipment, with a start date, expected return date, actual return date, daily/weekly rate, deposit amount, and return condition. 
When equipment comes back damaged or reaches a maintenance threshold (by usage hours or scheduled interval), I create a maintenance job: description of work needed, parts replaced, cost, and a status (pending → in progress → done). 

On the dashboard I need equipment availability by category, active rentals overdue for return, and equipment currently blocked for maintenance. A client's profile should show their full rental history and any damage incidents they caused — I also want to flag clients who have caused damage before.
